headlines.title: Chevron unveils $7 billion Venezuela deal as US claims a fifth of the country's oil
headlines.summary: Chevron announced a $7 billion expansion deal for its Venezuelan operations on Wednesday, hours after the country's parliament approved handing Washington control over a fifth of its oil reserves.

headlines.title: Energy ETFs to Watch as US-Venezuela Sign Historic Oil Deal
headlines.summary: Energy ETFs could benefit as the U.S.-Venezuela oil deal drives long-term investment in Venezuela's oil infrastructure.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs refreshes conviction lists on both sides of the Atlantic
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs updated its U.S. and European conviction lists for September, adding several new names as it refreshed its highest-conviction ideas heading into the autumn.

headlines.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise As Oil Prices Fall; Dell, Credo, Palo Alto Are Earnings Movers
headlines.summary: The Dow Jones and Nasdaq 100 fell below their 50-day lines as oil prices jumped. Dell, Palo Alto and Credo were earnings movers late.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
